कुञ्च् कुञ्च्, cl. 1. P. कुञ्चति, चुकुञ्च,
कुञ्चितुम्, to make crooked; to be
crooked; to bend or curve, to move crookedly; to
go; to go to or towards; to be or become small;
to lessen, to make small; to shrink, to contract, to
draw together: Caus. कुञ्चयति, -यितुम्: Desid.
चुकुञ्चिषति: Intens. चोकुच्यते; [cf. Hib. cuach-
aim, ‘I fold, plait;’ cuach, ‘a curl;’ cuachach,
‘curled, frizzled.’]

कुञ्च-फला, f. a kind of gourd, = कुष्माण्डी;
(a wrong reading for कुच-फल?).

कुञ्चि, इस्, f. a measure of capacity equal to eight
handfuls.

कुञ्चिका, f. a key; a fish, commonly Kuñciya, in
shape like an eel and eaten as one, Unibranchapertura
[]
Cuchiya, or the fish Muræna Apterygia, Synbrache
[cf. कुचिक]; a plant bearing a red and black seed
used as a weight, Abrus Precatorius; or another
plant bearing a pungent seed, Nigella Indica; a sort
of reed; the branch or shoot of a bamboo.

कुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked, curved, bent, con-
tracted, &c.; (अम्), n., N. of a plant.
—कुञ्चिताङ्-
गुलि (˚त-अङ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, with bent or curved fingers.

कुञ्ज् कुञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. कुञ्जति, -जितुम्, to
murmur, = कूज्.

कुञ्ज कुञ्ज, अस्, अम्, m. n. a place overrun
with plants or overgrown with creepers, a bower, an
arbour; a cave; the lower jaw; an elephant's tusk
or jaw; a tooth; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
—कुञ्ज-
कुटीर, अस्, m. a bower, an arbour.
—कुञ्ज-वल्लरी,
f., N. of a plant, = निकुञ्जिकाम्ला.

कुञ्जिका, f. another N. of the plant Kuñja-vallarī;
fennel-flower seed, = कुञ्चिका, Nigella Indica.

कुञ्जर कुञ्जर, अस्, m. (fr. कुञ्ज ?), an ele-
phant; anything pre-eminent in its kind (generally
in compounds, e. g. पुरुष-कुञ्जर, an eminent
man); the tree Ficus Religiosa; N. of a Nāga; N.
of a prince of the Sauvīraka race; N. of a mountain;
of a region; hair; (आ and ई), f. a female elephant;
(आ), f. the plant Bignonia Suaveolens; another plant,
Grislea Tomentosa.
—कुञ्जर-कर, अस्, m. an
elephant's trunk.
—कुञ्जर-क्षार-मूल, अम्, n.
a kind of radish (मूलक).
—कुञ्जर-ग्रह, अस्,
m. an elephant-catcher.
—कुञ्जर-दरी, f. ‘ele-
phant's cave,’ N. of a place.
—कुञ्जर-पिप्पली, f.,
N. of a plant described as bearing a fruit resembling
long pepper; [cf. गज-पिप्पली.]
—कुञ्जर-रूपिन्,
ई, इणी, इ, elephant-shaped.
—कुञ्जरानीक (˚र-अन्˚),
अम्, n. the division of an army consisting of ele-
phants, an elephant-corps.
—कुञ्जराराति (˚र-अर्˚),
इस्, m. a lion; the Śarabha, a fabulous animal with
eight legs, (‘enemy of the elephant.’)
—कुञ्जरा-
लुक (˚र-आल्˚), अम्, n. a species of esculent root, a
sort of yam.
—कुञ्जराशन (˚र-अश्˚), अस्, m. the
holy fig tree, Ficus Religiosa.

कुञ्जल कुञ्जल, अम्, n. sour gruel; [cf.
काञ्जिका.]
